usage: python -m coscc.loop [--root <dir>] <command>
  reading a .cos/ (these take --root):
    status [--json] | gate <unit> <stage> [--repo <dir>] | next <unit> [--repo <dir>] | new-path [--reserve-from <dir>]... <slug> | new-idea <slug> | unit-branch <unit> | pr-text <unit> | rerun <unit> [<stage>] | screens <unit> [--repo <dir>]
    status, gate, next, rerun, unit-branch, pr-text and screens need --state <file|->, the app's snapshot
  describing this checkout (these do not):
    check-branch [name] | check-tag <tag> | check-version

--root does not apply to `check-version`: it reports on the checkout of the working directory,
  not on a .cos/ somewhere else. Run it from the repository you mean.
